goal:
Rewrite C:/Projects/DS/DS_RPC/README.md (repo root; the ONLY file you may modify) as English user-facing documentation for real consumers of the DRPC NuGet packages (v2.13.0). The current README is Korean and too thin — replace it, absorbing still-accurate material (package table, build/test commands, Legacy archive note).

Sources to read first (authoritative, all inside this repo):
- Document/03-Reference/Public-API.md — authoritative public API surface; every API you document MUST exist here or in Sandbox/ code
- Document/01-Overview/Feature-Spec.md — implemented features F1-F9, F11-F14
- Document/04-Guides/Getting-Started.md — step-by-step usage flow
- Document/00-AI/CONTEXT.md — versions, build/test commands
- README.md — current Korean version; absorb still-accurate content (package table, build/test commands, Legacy archive section)
- Sandbox/Sandbox.Contracts, Sandbox/Sandbox.Server, Sandbox/Sandbox.Client — working example code
- Directory.Build.props — dependency versions

Hard rules:
- 100% English. No Korean characters anywhere in README.md.
- Never invent APIs, parameters, or versions. If unsure, verify against Public-API.md or Sandbox source; if it is not there, do not document it.
- Versions to state: DRPC 2.13.0, MessageProtocol 2.3.9, Communication.Network.RUDP.* 2.5.0 (verify in Directory.Build.props).
- You may modify ONLY README.md. Never touch Document/, Source/, Sandbox/, Test/.
- A new user must be able to go from zero to a working RPC round-trip using ONLY this README.
- Required strings that MUST appear: '## Quick Start' (exact heading), RemoteProcedure, RpcDeliveryMode, OneWay, NonIdMessage, GenericProcedure, TimeoutMs, Validation, DTLS, 'dotnet add package', Unity, ConnectAsync, ListenAsync, _Implementation, 'dotnet test', Legacy.

Required README structure (English Markdown):
1. Title + one-paragraph pitch (RUDP-based .NET RPC library; transport delegated to DS_Communication, serialization to DS_MessageProtocol, DRPC handles contract declaration, source generation, and runtime hubs)
2. Feature highlights list
3. '## Quick Start': install packages via dotnet add package -> declare contract interface with [RemoteProcedure] -> implement server _Implementation partial -> server ListenAsync + client ConnectAsync -> await generated *Async call. Copy-pasteable code mirroring Sandbox/ reality.
4. Usage sections covering ALL implemented features: declaration and method IDs; all five RpcDeliveryMode values; OneWay fire-and-forget; server->client reverse calls (two-way); DTO with [NonIdMessage]; group polymorphism; [GenericProcedure]; per-call TimeoutMs; Validation gate; DTLS packet encryption; error model; connection options
5. Packages table (5 packages + contents, netstandard2.1, Unity compatibility note)
6. Build & test commands (dotnet build / dotnet test DRPC.slnx -c Release) and runnable Sandbox example commands
7. Pointers: Document/ vault for deeper docs, Legacy/ archive note

When done, README.md must be complete and self-consistent. Your final message: one line listing the H2 sections you wrote.
